purpose: Courtroom lip-sync test: camera behind the judge's shoulder, same seed, made 3 ways.

scenes.scene: Courtroom drama shot inside a wood-panelled Indian High Court in daylight, filmed from behind the judge's shoulder: in the near foreground, slightly out of focus at the left edge of the frame, the back of a grey-haired judge's head and the shoulder of his black robe, above the edge of the raised wooden bench. Below the bench, in sharp focus, a tall Indian advocate in his fifties with silver hair, a thick moustache, black coat and white bands stands at the lectern, waist-up and filling a third of the frame, looking up at the judge (towards the camera), holding a thin file, and speaks firmly with clear, precise lip movements. Behind him, out of focus, a young woman advocate in a black coat with her hair in a bun takes notes at the bar table. Static camera, warm window light, ceiling fans.
scenes.dialogue: My Lord, the licence was cancelled without even hearing my client.
scenes.sound: Quiet courtroom murmur, a ceiling fan turning, papers rustling, the advocate's clear Indian-accented voice.
